description: Extreme Precipitation Event Catalog (EPEC) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Hunter Quintal, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (unc.edu). UPDATED 2026-07-13 The EPEC is a catalogue of labelled extreme precipitation events resolved at 0.03332 degrees (~4km) hourly across the Contiguous United States (CONUS) from January 2002 through December 2025. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 5 top-level files (CSV). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-22ce-n609. Keywords: Extreme Precipitation Events, Extreme Precipitation, Extreme Rainfall, Precipitation Events, Storm Events, Tropical Cyclone. Published 2026-01-21. Facility named: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, North Carolina State University. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
